calculate_charge_state_single_species: calculate the average charge state of a single impurity species from electron temperature using Mavrin 2018 polynomial fit
calculate_charge_state_mixture: calculate average impurity charge state for a mixture of species weighted by ion fractions
create_charge_state_info: create a ChargeStateInfo dataclass with Z_avg, Z2_avg, Z_per_species, and computed Z_mixture property
override_charge_state: override impurity charge state calculations with a prescribed constant Z value
summarize_charge_state_info: summarize the ChargeStateInfo dataclass containing average charge, squared charge, per-species charges, and effective mixture charge
